Bug_Title: Dm: Creation of ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor with zero core threads (DMI_SCHEDULED_THREAD_POOL_EXECUTOR_WITH_ZERO_CORE_THREADS)
Bug_Details:
(Javadoc)
A ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor with zero core threads will never execute anything; changes to the max pool size are ignored.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the code by creating a ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor with zero core threads. As per the bug rule, such an executor will never execute any tasks because it lacks the necessary core threads to run them. Consequently, even if tasks are scheduled, they will not be executed.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method of ScheduledExecutorBugExample, which creates a ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor with zero core threads. This configuration prevents any scheduled tasks from executing, causing the test to fail as no tasks are run.
